caption: The drawing depicts an object composed of two main materials and colors. The upper section consists of a wooden handle, shown in shades of brown with visible grain patterns, and is shaped with an ergonomic contour providing a firm grip between two flat, angled ends. Attached below the handle is a curved, dark brown blade that forms an arc from one end of the handle to the other. This composition forms an overall semi-circular tool with a continuous flow from the wooden grip through the distinct separation at the junction to the metal blade, all set against a plain, off-white background.
title: Food Chopper
